name: Tempester n°34: Revert Snd asks for a second press
explanation: Tempester n°34: the Revert Snd soft key asks for a second press before it discards the sound's edits (Main 1.5.0.2). Before: in the sound screens (16 Sounds + Sounds), one press of the soft key (key 0x21) under the label "Revert Snd" calls [routine](ctx, beat, pad): [routine](16, pad, beat, pad) copies the saved sound back over the edited one, with no way back. Eight screen states handle that key the same way (call sites below). After: the eight calls go to CONFIRM. A first press arms: the token beat * 32 + pad + 1 goes to [address] and nothing is reverted; the caller redraws its screen ([routine], or the self-transition's entry action [routine]) and the label hook shows "Confirm?" in place of "Revert Snd" while the token matches the selected beat and pad. A second press on the same beat and pad reverts (tail call to [routine]) and clears the token. Any other panel input clears it (signals 4-9 reaching [routine]: another key, an encoder, a control, a pad, a slider, the pedal; the soft key's own release and hold events keep it), and a token for another beat or pad never matches. This follows the firmware's own two-step confirmations ("Press 'Soft Key 1' to ...", "Save Now" over an existing file): the same key, pressed again, confirms. Shift + Undo Snd (same function, a deliberate two-key gesture) is unchanged. RAM: token u16 [address] (gp - 0x7c34), in the .bss hole [address]-[address] (Docs/analyses/feature-ui-fixes.md). Context: main loop (UI dispatch). [routine] is also reached from an ISR for event 10 (Song Position): signal 10 never touches the token. Flasher page untouched.
